rule: Only an element with a role carries aria-label or aria-labelledby, so axe never finds a name on a div, a span or a Plate
past: #29: CI run 46022609414 failed Sign out on webkit-phone with aria-prohibited-attr, because axe reached the home page while its loading skeleton, a Plate with aria-label, was showing; the billing skeleton and the new API key row had the same mistake

break.find: <PlateRow role="group" className="flex flex-col gap-3 px-5 py-4" aria-labelledby={id}>
break.replace: <PlateRow className="flex flex-col gap-3 px-5 py-4" aria-labelledby={id}>
